notes.title: Patch Notes: V1.01
notes.content: [p]Mage Tower Massacre Patch 1[/p][list][*][p]Added new character bios to the extras page[/p][/*][*][p]New character art by Sayton![/p][/*][*][p]Reduce fat fella collision sizes so they no longer get stuck in tight spaces[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced player hurtbox size[/p][/*][*][p]Increased enemy projectile visibility with bigger sprites and a glowing trail for arrows[/p][/*][*][p]Several menu fixes for ultrawide displays[/p][/*][/list][p]If you have a suggestion for an update or bugfix, please feel free to let me know![/p][p][/p][p]Semper games,[/p][p]-squid_lawyer[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Positive Review Status + Whats Next
notes.content: [p]With 10+ reviews, Mage Tower Massacre has now reached a positive rating on Steam! Massive thanks to anyone who left a review for the game. For those unfamiliar with Steam's algorithms, games get a massive boost in visibility in the store and discovery queue once they hit 10+ reviews. By leaving a review, you help the game (and me) out immensely! I've really been enjoying talking with those who have played the game and who are shooting for all the achievements.[/p][p][/p][p]Mage Tower Massacre is my first game and first release on Steam. The game is content complete, but I plan to keep supporting the game with updates and bugfixes for the foreseeable future. Here are some of the currently planned updates:[/p][list][*][p]\[BUGFIX] Reduce collision size of fat dudes so they can fit through tight areas better[/p][/*][*][p]Improved menus/UI for ultrawide displays[/p][/*][*][p]Increase visibility of enemy projectiles[/p][/*][*][p]Option to delete save and erase player progress through the menu[/p][/*][*][p]"How To Play" page[/p][/*][*][p]Improved art and character bios in the extras page for the 3 elite enemy types[/p][/*][*][p]an actual reward for achieving 3 million points (spoiler: the current reward is a bit of a middle finger)[/p][/*][*][p]new enemy types? (maybe...)[/p][/*][/list][p]If you have a suggestion for an update, or find any bugs, please feel free to let me know! I read and consider all player feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing, and shout-out to the Mage's Guild.[/p][p][/p][p]-squid_lawyer[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580020/8d56aa972db877480a0537e3a54e431842479605.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.content: [p]Hello fellow Mage Tower Masochists ːleatherneckː[/p][p][/p][p]Since the game launched, I have been testing the game out more thoroughly on Steam Deck and have received reports from other players as well that the game functions as expected. With this being a small game release, its unlikely to be reviewed by Valve for Steam Deck Verification any time soon. With that in mind, here are the features that are supported on Steam Deck:[/p][list][*][p]Full controller support with correct button names and layout for Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Rebindable controls[/p][/*][*][p]PC <-> Steam Deck cloud saves[/p][/*][/list][p]If you find an issue with the game on Steam Deck, please let me know and I'll do my best to fix it immediately![/p][p][/p][p]-squid_lawyer[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45580020/8d56aa972db877480a0537e3a54e431842479605.png"][/img][/p]
